name: Puppeteer (Multi-Agent Orchestration Framework)
description: Puppeteer is a centralized multi-agent orchestration framework where a 'puppeteer' orchestrator directs a pool of heterogeneous agent 'puppets' to collaboratively solve complex tasks. The orchestrator's policy is trained via reinforcement learning (REINFORCE) to adaptively sequence and prioritize agents based on evolving task state, pruning less effective agents over time. Analysis reveals emergent structural phenomena including 'compaction' (concentration of communication among hub agents) and 'cyclicality' (closed-loop feedback routes for recursive critique).
reputation: Research framework demonstrating emergent collaboration structures via RL-trained orchestration; applied to ALFWorld as an embodied environment.
notes: Demonstrates structural self-evolution at the orchestration level rather than task content level. Applied to ALFWorld (embodied) and text-based tasks. Emergent compaction and cyclicality are qualitative findings.
